How I work

The process behind

every product.

Listen

/01

Find the real problem first.

  • +Talk to real users first.
  • +Ask why until it’s clear.
  • +Agree on goals and limits.

Ideate

/02

Explore wide, then pick what matters.

  • +Map users, flows and market.
  • +Sketch many, keep the best.
  • +Decide what ships first.

Design

/03

Make it real, test it, refine it.

  • +Design it in Figma.
  • +Prototype in Claude Code.
  • +Test with real users.

Launch

/04

Ship it, then keep learning.

  • +Launch small, watch closely.
  • +Measure what people do.
  • +Learn, then ship again.
